**Download** `TokenScope-Setup-1.0.5.exe` below and run it. It updates TokenScope in place, and your data stays.

Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the installer isn't code-signed yet. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

**Estimates learn per tool**
- Each AI tool's estimates are now corrected from its own finished plans. Tools differ a lot: Cursor runs many actions in one request, so the same work cost about a tenth of the estimate there.
- After 2 finished plans in a tool, its new estimates are corrected. Until then, a tool uses the correction from plans with an exact cost.
- The Plans tab shows the corrected estimates, the same numbers your AI sees.

**Spending**
- Conversations archived in Cursor, Codex or OpenCode are labelled Archived. Their cost still counts.
- The tool and model filters no longer move the list when you pick something, and keep their space while Spending loads.

After updating, restart your AI tools once so they use the new version.
